decisions: Keep success terminal versus processing/cancellation; terminal conflicts queue manual review. Cancellation is a request, not proof money cannot move: later success supersedes cancellation. Missing sequence rejects 422; unknown refund rejects 404; same sequence/different body is conflict.
assumptions: Synthetic fixture policy frozen for the narrowed slice, not invented user approval for production.
pending: No HTTP adapter, real payment dispatch, database transaction engine, distributed delivery, fsync/power-loss guarantees, or production secrets.
approval_status: No external policy owner consultation claimed
